limitations: Metadata-only InMemory model of the proposed standard Duende context, not the currently registered in-memory stores or any live database
No relational SQL types, physical tables, index/constraint enforcement, provider parity, migrations, token issuance or revocation proven
No database created/opened or SaveChanges invoked; all data are type/field metadata, never stored credential or grant values
The existing three-context 88-entity inventory remains a separate historical denominator; these contexts supplement it without overwriting it
